questions.question: Which three books are the cheapest, and what do they cost together?
questions.answer: The three cheapest books are The Alchemist at ₹299, Atomic Habits at ₹399, and Deep Work at ₹449. Their combined cost is ₹299 + ₹399 + ₹449, which equals ₹1,147. Since there is an offer for any three books for ₹999, the total cost for this set would be ₹999. I recommend choosing these three books as they represent the lowest individual prices listed.

questions.question: How much do Clean Code and The Pragmatic Programmer cost together? Would I pay less if I add The Alchemist as a third book?
questions.expected: 529 + 549 = 1,078 for two; three books cost 999 with the offer
questions.answer:
The combined cost of Clean Code and The Pragmatic Programmer is ₹529 + ₹549, which equals ₹1078.

If you add The Alchemist as a third book, the total cost would be ₹529 + ₹549 + ₹299, which equals ₹1377.

Therefore, you would not pay less; adding The Alchemist would increase the total cost by ₹299. However, since you are purchasing three books, you can take advantage of the offer for any 3 books for ₹999, which would be cheaper than the sum of the individual prices.

questions.answer: If you pay yearly for the Pro plan, you save ₹998 in one year. The monthly price is ₹499, so the yearly price is ₹4,990. This calculation is based on the stated savings on the page.

questions.question: We are a team of 7 people and we need priority support. Which plan should we choose?
questions.answer:
You should choose the Team plan. The Team plan includes 5 users and offers priority support, which is a requirement for your team. To accommodate 7 people, you will need to pay for the two extra users.

The cost calculation is as follows:
The base price for the Team plan is ₹1,499 per month for 5 users.
You need 2 extra users (7 total users - 5 included users).
The cost for extra users is 2 x ₹250 per month, which equals ₹500 per month.
The total monthly cost for 7 users would be ₹1,499 + ₹500 = ₹1,999 per month.

This option meets your requirement for priority support and accommodates all 7 team members.
